name: Marienheide (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, the white stripe narrow, crossed by a white band bearing the red lion of the municipal arms of Marienheide, with crossed white tools at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Marienheide; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: white band with the red lion
